title: Pork Satay Skewers
description: A delicious and easy-to-make Malaysian-inspired dish featuring marinated pork tenderloin, grilled to perfection on skewers.
instructions: 1. In a blender, combine peanut sauce, coconut milk, soy sauce, fish sauce, brown sugar, coriander, chili flakes, garlic, and lemongrass. Blend until smooth.
2. In a large bowl, whisk together the marinade ingredients. Add the pork tenderloin and mix until coated.
3. Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
5. Thread the marinated pork onto satay skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
6. Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, until the pork is cooked through.
7. Brush the skewers with the remaining marinade during the last 2 minutes of grilling.
8. Serve the pork satay skewers hot with your favorite dipping sauce.
